svg.aria-label: lakehouse-cdc-streaming: Change data capture from Postgres into Iceberg, with a harness that proves the lake still matches the source. 5 failure modes: duplicates, reordering, schema change, deletes, crashes. Runs locally with docker compose. Not deployed.
